name: VAT Report
report_script:
result = []

company = filters.get("company")
if not company:
    frappe.throw("Please select a Company")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

company_abbr = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "abbr")
vat_account = f"VAT - {company_abbr}"

sales = frappe.db.sql("""
    select si.name, si.posting_date, si.customer, si.net_total, sit.tax_amount
    from `tabSales Invoice` si
    inner join `tabSales Taxes and Charges` sit on sit.parent = si.name
    where si.docstatus = 1
    and si.company = %(company)s
    and si.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
    and sit.account_head = %(vat_account)s
""", {"company": company, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "vat_account": vat_account}, as_dict=True)

total_output_vat = 0
total_taxable_sales = 0
for s in sales:
    total_output_vat += s.tax_amount or 0
    total_taxable_sales += s.net_total or 0
    result.append({
        "type": "Output VAT (Sales)",
        "reference": s.name,
        "date": s.posting_date,
        "party": s.customer,
        "taxable_amount": s.net_total,
        "vat_amount": s.tax_amount
    })

purchases = frappe.db.sql("""
    select pi.name, pi.posting_date, pi.supplier, pi.net_total, pit.tax_amount
    from `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
    inner join `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges` pit on pit.parent = pi.name
    where pi.docstatus = 1
    and pi.company = %(company)s
    and pi.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
    and pit.account_head = %(vat_account)s
""", {"company": company, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "vat_account": vat_account}, as_dict=True)

total_input_vat = 0
total_taxable_purchases = 0
for p in purchases:
    total_input_vat += p.tax_amount or 0
    total_taxable_purchases += p.net_total or 0
    result.append({
        "type": "Input VAT (Purchase)",
        "reference": p.name,
        "date": p.posting_date,
        "party": p.supplier,
        "taxable_amount": p.net_total,
        "vat_amount": p.tax_amount
    })

net_vat = total_output_vat - total_input_vat
result.append({
    "type": "--- SUMMARY ---",
    "reference": "",
    "date": "",
    "party": f"Taxable Sales: {total_taxable_sales} | Taxable Purchases: {total_taxable_purchases}",
    "taxable_amount": None,
    "vat_amount": None
})
result.append({
    "type": "Net VAT Payable" if net_vat >= 0 else "Net VAT Refundable",
    "reference": "",
    "date": "",
    "party": "",
    "taxable_amount": None,
    "vat_amount": abs(net_vat)
})

name: IBA Customer Ledger
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Particulars", "fieldname": "particulars", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 250},
    {"label": "Voucher No", "fieldname": "reference", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Debit", "fieldname": "debit", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Credit", "fieldname": "credit", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Balance", "fieldname": "balance", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
]
result = []
customer = filters.get("customer")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")
company = filters.get("company")

if customer and from_date and to_date and company:
    opening = frappe.db.sql("""
        select sum(debit) as debit, sum(credit) as credit
        from `tabGL Entry`
        where party_type='Customer' and party=%(customer)s and company=%(company)s
        and posting_date < %(from_date)s and is_cancelled=0
    """, {"customer": customer, "from_date": from_date, "company": company}, as_dict=True)[0]

    opening_balance = frappe.utils.flt(opening.debit) - frappe.utils.flt(opening.credit)
    result.append({"date": None, "particulars": "Opening Balance", "reference": "", "debit": 0, "credit": 0, "balance": opening_balance})

    txns = frappe.db.sql("""
        select posting_date, voucher_type, voucher_no, debit, credit
        from `tabGL Entry`
        where party_type='Customer' and party=%(customer)s and company=%(company)s
        and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and is_cancelled=0
        order by posting_date asc
    """, {"customer": customer, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date, "company": company}, as_dict=True)

    running = opening_balance
    total_debit = 0
    total_credit = 0
    for t in txns:
        running += frappe.utils.flt(t.debit) - frappe.utils.flt(t.credit)
        total_debit += frappe.utils.flt(t.debit)
        total_credit += frappe.utils.flt(t.credit)
        result.append({
            "date": t.posting_date,
            "particulars": t.voucher_type,
            "reference": t.voucher_no,
            "debit": frappe.utils.flt(t.debit),
            "credit": frappe.utils.flt(t.credit),
            "balance": running
        })

    result.append({"date": None, "particulars": "TOTAL", "reference": "", "debit": total_debit, "credit": total_credit, "balance": running})

from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

conditions = "gle.company = %(company)s and acc.root_type = 'Expense' and gle.is_cancelled = 0"

    conditions += " and gle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s"

    inner join `tabAccount` acc on acc.name = gle.account
    where {conditions}
    order by gle.posting_date desc

    total += frappe.utils.flt(r.amount)
    result.append({

        "account": r.account,

name: IBA Executive Dashboard
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Metric", "fieldname": "metric", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 250},
    {"label": "Value", "fieldname": "value", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 180},
]
result = []

company = filters.get("company")
period = filters.get("period") or "This Month"
custom_from = filters.get("from_date")
custom_to = filters.get("to_date")

t = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today())

from_date = None
to_date = None

if period == "Today":
    from_date = t
    to_date = t
elif period == "This Week":
    from_date = frappe.utils.add_days(t, -t.weekday())
    to_date = t
elif period == "This Month":
    from_date = frappe.utils.get_first_day(t)
    to_date = t
elif period == "Last Month":
    last_month = frappe.utils.add_months(t, -1)
    from_date = frappe.utils.get_first_day(last_month)
    to_date = frappe.utils.get_last_day(last_month)
elif period == "This Year":
    from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(str(t.year) + "-01-01")
    to_date = t
elif period == "Last Year":
    from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(str(t.year - 1) + "-01-01")
    to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(str(t.year - 1) + "-12-31")
elif period == "Custom" and custom_from and custom_to:
    from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(custom_from)
    to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(custom_to)
else:
    from_date = frappe.utils.get_first_day(t)
    to_date = t

company_cond = "and company = %(company)s" if company else ""
values = {"from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date}
if company:
    values["company"] = company

def sql_sum(query, vals):
    r = frappe.db.sql(query, vals)
    return r[0][0] if r and r[0][0] else 0

total_sales = sql_sum(f"select sum(grand_total) from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus=1 and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {company_cond}", values)
total_purchase = sql_sum(f"select sum(grand_total) from `tabPurchase Invoice` where docstatus=1 and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {company_cond}", values)
payments_received = sql_sum(f"select sum(paid_amount) from `tabPayment Entry` where docstatus=1 and payment_type='Receive' and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {company_cond}", values)
payments_made = sql_sum(f"select sum(paid_amount) from `tabPayment Entry` where docstatus=1 and payment_type='Pay' and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {company_cond}", values)

gl_cond = "and gle.company = %(company)s" if company else ""
total_expenses = sql_sum(f"""
    select sum(gle.debit - gle.credit) from `tabGL Entry` gle
    inner join `tabAccount` acc on acc.name = gle.account
    where acc.root_type = 'Expense' and gle.is_cancelled=0
    and gle.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {gl_cond}
""", values)
total_revenue = sql_sum(f"""
    select sum(gle.credit - gle.debit) from `tabGL Entry` gle
    inner join `tabAccount` acc on acc.name = gle.account
    where acc.root_type = 'Income' and gle.is_cancelled=0
    and gle.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s {gl_cond}
""", values)
net_profit = (total_revenue or 0) - (total_expenses or 0)

stock_cond = "and w.company = %(company)s" if company else ""
stock_value = sql_sum(f"""
    select sum(b.stock_value) from `tabBin` b
    inner join `tabWarehouse` w on w.name = b.warehouse
    where 1=1 {stock_cond}
""", values)

item_cond = "and company_owner = %(company)s" if company else ""
total_items = frappe.db.sql(f"select count(*) from `tabItem` where 1=1 {item_cond}", values)[0][0] or 0

bank_cond = "and gle.company = %(company)s" if company else ""
bank_balance = sql_sum(f"""
    select sum(gle.debit - gle.credit) from `tabGL Entry` gle
    inner join `tabAccount` acc on acc.name = gle.account
    where acc.account_type in ('Bank','Cash') and gle.is_cancelled=0 {bank_cond}
""", values)

recv_cond = "and company = %(company)s" if company else ""
receivables = sql_sum(f"select sum(outstanding_amount) from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus=1 and outstanding_amount > 0 {recv_cond}", values)
payables = sql_sum(f"select sum(outstanding_amount) from `tabPurchase Invoice` where docstatus=1 and outstanding_amount > 0 {recv_cond}", values)

rows = [
    ("Total Sales", total_sales),
    ("Total Purchase", total_purchase),
    ("Total Payments Received", payments_received),
    ("Total Payments Made", payments_made),
    ("Total Revenue (Income)", total_revenue),
    ("Total Expenses", total_expenses),
    ("Net Profit", net_profit),
    ("Total Stock Value", stock_value),
    ("Total Items (count)", total_items),
    ("Bank & Cash Balance", bank_balance),
    ("Outstanding Receivables", receivables),
    ("Outstanding Payables", payables),
